sources.notes: Canonical HiKorea notice for the latest official manuals: '260623 체류민원 자격별 안내 매뉴얼.hwpx', '260617 사증민원 자격별 안내 매뉴얼.hwp', '260623 사증.체류 민원 자격별 안내 매뉴얼 수정 이력.hwpx'. This is the authoritative source the product links to from the landing 'Information & coverage' panel. Desktop Codex on 2026-06-25 confirmed the notice page and downloaded all three attachments through the normal public attachment endpoint; normalized copies and diagnostics are preserved under backend/data/sources/manuals. The 260623 stay manual and 260623 change log are valid distribution/protected HWPX packages with encrypted section bodies, so they remain unreadable for source-grounded data promotion. No scraping by default.

A 2026-06-14 reachability probe with the .env.example placeholder OC value returned HTTP 403, so a real registered OC is required for live retrieval.
